headline: Legal Assistant

education.credential: Bachelor of Arts in Political Science
notes: Thesis: access to barangay justice in coastal communities

summary: Political science graduate with a year as a legal assistant in a general-practice law office. I draft pleadings and affidavits from templates, compile and organise case files, research jurisprudence and check contracts for missing terms before the lawyer's review. I plan to enter law school next year.

projects.name: Barangay justice research
projects.description: Interviewed 30 barangay officials and residents on how disputes are settled through the barangay justice system and wrote recommendations for faster settlements.

skills: Legal documentation: pleadings, affidavits, notarial documents
Legal research on laws and jurisprudence
Compliance with court and notarial rules

experience.title: Legal Assistant
bullets: Draft complaints, answers, affidavits and demand letters from the lawyers' notes.
Compile case records and annexes and prepare indexed folders for hearings.
Research laws and Supreme Court decisions and summarise them in short memos.
Check leases and sale contracts for missing or inconsistent terms before review.
Keep the notarial register and court filing log up to date.

experience.title: Legal Research Intern
bullets: Summarised case files and interviewed clients with the foundation's lawyers.
